meta.title: Tesuch — would you pass a labour inspection today?
meta.description: Tesuch checks employment contract deadlines every night, scores your inspection readiness and alerts you on Telegram and by email before a legal deadline is missed.

hero.title: If the inspector came today, would you pass?
hero.subtitle: Tesuch checks every employment contract each night, scores your inspection readiness and warns you on Telegram or by email before a legal deadline is missed.

stats.euHint: data stored in an EU region

steps.d: A CSV or Excel file with headers in Armenian, Russian or English. Columns are recognised automatically.
Every night the rules check each contract and calculate the deadlines.
A new issue triggers a Telegram message and an email, and every Monday you get a weekly digest.
Download the order template as a PDF, fix the issue and watch the score go up.

firms.title: Every client on one dashboard
firms.desc: 20–50 companies, each with its own score. The riskiest sit at the top, so you know where to start this week.

owners.title: One message a week
owners.desc: No need to read the whole Labour Code. Every Monday you get a short Telegram digest with 1–3 concrete steps.
tgLines: Probation ends in 5 days — decide whether to confirm
owners.tgFooter: Advisory: not yet verified by a lawyer

items.d: Every check is written as a versioned rule and covered by tests. The same data always gives the same result.
Every alert names its source and links to arlis.am.
All rules are still being reviewed by a lawyer, so they show as “Advisory”. We never invent article numbers.
The database runs in a European Union region. We keep only what the rules need.
Each firm sees only its own data — enforced in the database itself and verified by automated tests.

items.a: No. Tesuch is an information tool. It shows risks and points to the law, but talk to a lawyer before you decide. Rules a lawyer hasn't verified yet are marked “Advisory”.

items.q: We already use ArmSoft. Why Tesuch?
items.a: ArmSoft stores your HR records; Tesuch checks them against the law and warns you before deadlines. You can import staff from an ArmSoft CSV or Excel export.

items.q: What employee data do you store?
items.a: Only what the rules need: name, date of birth (for the minors rule), and contract and leave dates. No passport details, addresses or salaries.
Probation, fixed-term contracts, dismissal grounds and notice periods, annual leave, maternity leave and contract registration on the SRC e-platform. The list will grow.
Pricing isn't set yet. We're choosing the first pilot firms now — leave your email after the self-check.

cta.title: Start with a 2-minute check
cta.desc: 10 questions about how your company actually works. See your result straight away.

footer.disclaimer: Tesuch is an information tool, not legal advice. Rules marked “Advisory” have not yet been verified by a lawyer. Before making a decision, consult a lawyer and check the current text of the law on arlis.am.
